notes: Two independent defects: (1) jsonld.flatten called with {documentLoader} in the @context (2nd) position instead of the options (3rd) position -> every block throws 'Invalid JSON-LD syntax; @context term values must be strings or objects' -> expansion-failed, zero nodes. (2) extractGraph only accepted {@graph:[...]} and single-node objects, not the array flatten resolves to -> silent zero-node extraction even on success. (3) offlineContext did not inject a default @vocab for context-less blocks -> zero facts from the Acme test block. Minimal fix: move documentLoader to 3rd arg; accept arrays first in extractGraph; inject {'@vocab': schema.org} default when no @context.
